binds.giver: the one who asks for help
binds.village: the village the tale happens in
binds.rival: the head of another house of the giver's realm

stages.journal: Find out why the miller of {village} has shut his mill.
stages.canvas: The lord asks you to find out why the miller of {village} will not grind his grain.

choices.label: Go to the mill
choices.canvas: The mill is shut. The miller will say only that a lord's men came by night.

{giver}: The player went to the mill of {village}.

choices.label: Tell the lord
canvas: The lord hears it and goes quiet.

canvas.text: He asks what else the miller said.
He wants to hear it from the miller himself.

the_lord_hears.memory: The player told me why the mill of {village} stopped.

the_rival_answers.memory: The player asked me about the mill of {village}.

silence.journal: You let the mill stay shut.
